method.hit: Maximum probability within 1 pixel of any eligible target pixel; first row/column target pixels ineligible, matching official ShootingRules
method.camera_split: Fresh profile mean >=0.3 px/frame is moving
method.merged: Same-band merged components retain that band; cross-band are mixed; any unknown or duplicate speed key gives unknown
method.shares: Exposure and miss shares within each threshold/clip/camera stratum
method.box_metric: Separate NMS+greedy box matching from gt.csv; not ShootingRules

limitations: Counts are target-frame components or box-frames, not unique physical targets.
Relative speeds depend on box-masked homography estimates; residual error may change a speed band.
Reconstructed Gaussian masks and cached float16 logits can differ from the released official log.
This stratification establishes association, not that stationarity caused a miss or MXC will fix it.
